result.edit: The failure occurs when processing a new group after a mismatch. The current implementation incorrectly transitions from sf4 to sf1 unconditionally, losing the ability to detect sequences starting with '0' in the next group. The change makes sf4 conditionally transition based on the input data, preserving the ability to start a new sequence match when the next group begins with '0'. This should fix the output mismatch observed at cycle 12 where the expected output was '01' but got '00'.
